name: Vacation rental (Airbnb) photography prices from photographers' price lists
description: Published prices of 63 photographers who shoot vacation rentals in 24 US markets (Smoky Mountains, Destin-30A, Orlando-Kissimmee, Scottsdale, Lake Tahoe, Maui and more), read from each business's own page on 18 November 2026: the smallest and a large rental package, whether the package is named for Airbnb or vacation rentals, photos included, twilight, drone, video and 3D tour add-ons, lifestyle or styling, turnaround, the source URL and notes on comparability.
creator: October (october-ai.com)

changelog.change: First release: 63 price lists in 24 markets, each read from the business's own page on 18 November 2026.

fields.name: market
fields.description: The US vacation-rental market the business serves.

fields.name: business
fields.description: The photographer or company, as its site names it.

fields.name: url
fields.description: The page the row was read from.

fields.name: checked
fields.description: The day the page was read (YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.name: pricing_basis
fields.description: How the page prices: flat package, by bedrooms, sqft tiers or per photo.

fields.name: str_package
fields.description: true when the package is named for Airbnb, vacation or short-term rentals; false for a general real estate package the page offers to rental owners.

fields.name: photos_small_usd
fields.description: Cheapest photo package for the smallest property tier (studio to 2 bedrooms, or the smallest size tier), in US dollars.

fields.name: small_tier
fields.description: That tier as the page writes it.

fields.name: photos_large_usd
fields.description: Photo package for a 4 to 5 bedroom or about 3,000 sq ft and larger property, where listed.

fields.name: large_tier
fields.description: That tier as the page writes it.

fields.name: photos_included
fields.description: Edited photos in the cheapest package, as the page states it.

fields.name: twilight_usd

fields.name: video_usd
fields.description: Cheapest video add-on (0 = included); can be a slideshow of photos, notes say which.

fields.name: lifestyle_or_staging
fields.description: true when the page offers styling, staging or lifestyle shots (models, food) with the shoot.

fields.name: turnaround
fields.description: Delivery time as the page states it.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Anything that changes comparability: starting-at prices, travel fees, service area, contradictions on the page.

rows.notes: Real estate photographer; the Base package is suggested 'for smaller listings or rentals' (no named STR package). Plus tax. Base includes 3 drone photos and a 2D floor plan, so drone = 0. A cheaper a la carte option exists: 25 photos $250 (floor plan included). Twilight = 4 virtual twilights $125 (real twilight 4 photos $195). Video = vertical walk-through reel $225 (60-sec video $295). 3D = Zillow $175 (Matterport $250). States no travel charges within its service area.

Real estate photographer; no separate STR package, but the page describes the $350 Luxury Package as suited to 'Airbnb or short term rental properties'. A cheaper Standard Package is $250 (30 photos, + tax). Extra photos $15 (Luxury). Drone add-on $150 (standalone drone $225). Video = 1-min drone video $375. 3D = Matterport $300 up to 2,000 sq ft. No twilight or travel fees listed.

Offers 'Airbnb or Rental Photography' with lifestyle/artistic shots, priced 'like Real Estate' by number of photos; no separate rental price. All prices are 'starting at'; photo count for the $175 price not tied explicitly (12 is the smallest option listed). Twilight = first dusk photo $185 (+$15 each). Drone add-on 6 photos $75. Video from $375. Matterport from $175 (or +$75 with a floor plan). Read in built-in browser (plain fetch 403).

rows.small_tier: Airbnb Essentials (12 photos; tiers by photo count, not size)
rows.turnaround: Next day by 6 PM (page also says '2-Day Delivery')
rows.notes: Serves San Antonio and Austin. Tiers: Essentials $279/12, Prime $449/20, Prime+ from $599/30 (+2 drone), E+lte from $749/40 (+6 drone), Elite PLUS from $999 (+6 sunset photos). Add-ons are 'starting at': twilight $199, aerial photo/video $99, Instagram reel $149; 3D floor plan $79 (a floor plan, not a 3D tour). Turnaround stated two different ways. No travel fees listed.

rows.small_tier: Rental photography package, 12 photos (no size tiers)
rows.notes: Texas-wide rental and short-term rental price list (DFW, Houston, Austin, San Antonio); no Austin-specific rates. Contradiction: page says photography 'starts at $159' for rentals but lists the 12-photo package at $169. Extra photos 'at reduced cost' (no figure). Twilight = digital twilight +$29 (twilight time slot $79). Aerial $79-$119, HD video $159-$319, Matterport $149-$199. No virtual staging for Airbnb/VRBO listings. Travel fee possible in outlying areas (no amount).

rows.small_tier: Daytime photography basic package, up to 10 stills (no size tier)
rows.notes: Houston-based; page metadata says it serves Houston, Austin and San Antonio. All prices + tax; unlimited license included. Extra photos $12.50. Twilight = day-to-dusk conversion $50/photo (real dusk package $350/10 stills). Drone $155 with a shoot. Video = Photo-to-Motion $125 (highlight reel from $325). 3D = Zillow 3D tour $125 up to 3,000 sq ft (Matterport from $225). Bundles are sq-ft tiered: Basics $552 (0-3,000) / $582 (3,001-6,000). Drive-time fee in outer zones (no amount), weekend shoot $100.

Lake Arrowhead & Big Bear page; mentions mountain cabin/Airbnb rentals but packages are real-estate packages tiered by listing value, not size. All 'From' prices: Premium $395 (HDR photos, 3D virtual tour, schematic floor plan); Premium Plus $539 (adds drone photo/video, social reel, virtual twilight); Aurora $645 (HDR, drone, real twilight); Luxury $1,900 (flash photography, 4K Matterport, cinematic video, real twilight). No photo counts or standalone add-on prices. Travel fees not stated.

rows.small_tier: Real Estate Photography in Big Bear (no size tiers)
rows.notes: $249 for '30+' interior & exterior images, 1 year storage; page says it covers realtors, property managers or 'an airbnb'. Business is San Diego-based (office Point Loma); page says projects over 30 miles from the office 'might' incur an additional charge - Big Bear is well beyond that, so a travel charge may apply (amount not stated). Twilight/other packages named but not priced on this page.

rows.small_tier: Signature Stay (units up to 3,000 sq ft)
rows.turnaround: 48 hours or less on most properties
rows.notes: Branson-based. Signature Stay $300 includes drone; Premier Stay $550 adds sunset/twilight; Lifestyle $1,000 = staged shoot with food and props. Above 3,000 sq ft +$50 per 1,000 sq ft (no 4-5 BR price stated). Photo count: 'As many as it takes'. Twilight = virtual twilight $25/photo (sunset session from $300). Video/reels from $200. Matterport listed with no price on this page (the site's real estate page shows $200 and virtual twilight $20). Light staging/table styling included. Same-day rush fee (no amount).

rows.turnaround: Next-day (24 hours from end of shoot)
rows.notes: Flat STR packages, same prices across its markets (Branson, Springfield, NW Arkansas, Kansas City, Tulsa). Base $229 includes 1 virtual twilight (so twilight = 0). Signature STR $397 (35 photos, 3 drone, 6 AI lifestyle images, 30-sec reel); Elite STR $697 (50 photos, 8 drone, 60-sec walkthrough). No standalone drone/video/3D add-on prices. 'AI Lifestyle' images are AI-generated, not a styled shoot. No travel fees listed.

rows.small_tier: Vacation & Short-Term Rental package (size not specified)
rows.notes: STR package $595: up to 55 images, lifestyle & amenity photos, aerial, nearby community features, virtual twilight hero, 2D floor plan. General size-tiered packages: Essential $395 (~1,200 sq ft, 25 images) up to Luxury $995 (~4,000-5,500 sq ft). Twilight 0 = virtual twilight included; on-location twilight $200 add-on. 3D = Matterport $400. No travel fees in Summit County. Cinematic video quote-only.

Broken Bow-based real estate/wedding/portrait photographer; real estate page targets luxury cabins (no named STR package). Prices are 'starting rates'. Travel fees may apply beyond 30 miles of Broken Bow. ashleybaxterphotography.com redirects to this base44.app site; search snippets showed older different prices ($275/20 photos) that are not on the page today. Read in built-in browser.

rows.small_tier: All photography services 'start at $500 per shoot'
rows.notes: STR photography for Broken Bow / Hochatown cabins. Only price published is the $500 starting rate; varies by cabin size, number of rooms, add-ons and location; custom quote for exact price. Twilight, drone, lifestyle staging and virtual staging listed as services without prices.

rows.small_tier: Essential photo package (properties up to 2,500 sq ft)

Standard $300 includes drone (no standalone drone price). Twilight/golden hour $125 (second visit). Video = listing video $300. Cape Cod Complete $1,200. Floor plan included under 5,000 sq ft. Search snippets showed older prices ($200/$250/$699) not on the page today.

rows.small_tier: Exterior and interior, homes 3,000 sq ft or less
rows.large_tier: Exterior and interior, homes over 3,000 sq ft

Aerial only sold as bundle: $375 (<=3,000 sq ft) / $475 (>3,000) with aerial, i.e. $100 more than photos only; no standalone add-on price. Mileage surcharge possible outside the area (no amount). Drone near Otis Base needs FAA authorization. No twilight, video or 3D.

East Sandwich, MA; serves Cape Cod. Package designed for Airbnb/Vrbo; only a starting price, no tiers or photo count. Aerial add-on $100 (standalone from $200). rows.small_tier: Limited coverage, up to 15 images (land or properties under about 1,000 sq ft)

Twilight = virtual twilight $25 per photo or 3 for $60. Drone add-on $65. Photo count not stated. Travel fee not stated on this page.

rows.small_tier: Basic Real Estate Package (half-day, no size tier)

Real estate photographer covering Houston, Galveston, League City, Crystal Beach; markets itself as 'Houston Airbnb Photographer' (portfolio page title) but has no rental package, so these are general real estate prices. rows.small_tier: Listing 20 (20 listing photos, incl. 2D floor plan)

rows.small_tier: 15 images (key rooms of condo or home)

Drone 'starts at $125'. Amenities from $50. Condos shot 'for sale or rent'. Serves Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, Perdido Key, Pensacola, Baldwin County.

Packages: Essential $150, Enhanced $350 (adds video walkthrough + 5 drone shots), Premium $550 (adds Matterport). No standalone add-on prices. Same-day delivery $150, 12-hour rush $99. Main real-estate page says 'Packages start at $149' (contradiction with $150).

'Real Estate & Rental Photography' page (rental covered, but not an STR-named package). Minimum photo counts 30/40/50/60 by tier; $200 up to 3,000; $300 up to 5,000. 45-60 min sessions. Locations must be within 15 miles of Hilton Head Island. No add-on prices listed.

Tiers by listing price, not size/bedrooms: Simple $199 (15 photos), Basic $249 (20), Standard $299 (25), Deluxe $399 (30), Premium $499 (40), Luxury $599 (50), $3.9M+ $20/image (40 min); extra stills $15. Service area includes South Lake Tahoe, Zephyr Cove, Tahoe City, Incline, Truckee. Sunset add-on, aerial, video, Matterport offered but not priced. No vacation rental mention; no travel fee listed.

rows.turnaround: Usually 24-48 hours for smaller shoots; 4-5 days or longer for larger shoots with add-ons
rows.notes: 'Starting at $185'; larger luxury homes/high-end rentals custom priced; full price list only sent on contact. Add-ons listed without prices: lifestyle shoots with models, area photos, floorplans, walkthrough video, virtual twilight etc. No travel fees stated; may accept a stay at the property as trade/partial credit for out-of-area jobs. Shooting Tahoe rentals since 2014.

Based in Dayton, NV; lists Lake Tahoe in service area. General real estate packages (no vacation rental mention). Silver: 20-30+ images + 3-5 aerials, floor plan, day-to-dusk conversion, slideshow; $415/$490/$520/$675/$750 by size up to 7,000 sq ft (4,000-4,999 $675). Gold (adds listing video) $610-$1,055. Twilight photo $175 (second trip). Free mileage within 50 miles (another section says 25), then $0.80/mile round trip. Search snippets showed older $320 tier; page today shows $415.

rows.small_tier: Vacation Rental Photo, up to 1,500 sq ft
rows.notes: Vacation Rental photo $800 incl. drone photos and sunset or lifestyle setup (up to 1,500 sq ft). Video $1,000 and 3D Matterport $600 are separate vacation-rental products (not discounted add-ons). Escrow/real estate photo $600. No photo count, turnaround or travel fee stated; larger sizes not priced.

$499 for up to 30 interior & lanai photos; +$100 per additional 10 photos; recreational areas/amenities from $150 with session ($200 standalone); TV artwork $25/room. Staging from $100 (flowers, local wine, faux fruit). Pitched at vacation home owners but no named rental package. No twilight/drone/video/3D, turnaround or travel fees stated.

rows.small_tier: Condo / Vacation Rental 1 bed, 1 bath (generally 500 sq ft or less)
rows.large_tier: Condo / Vacation Rental 4+ bed (generally 2,500 sq ft or less)
rows.notes: Wailuku; Maui County single-use pricing (multiple-use requires contact). Condo/VR: 1BR $220, 2-3BR $275, 4+BR $330. Houses: 1-2BR $250, 3-4BR $300, 5+BR $400, over 4,000 sq ft $600. Drone photos $200; 3D walk-through $300; video with drone & music $300; same-day rush $200; virtual staging/declutter $30/photo. No photo counts, twilight, standard turnaround or travel fee stated.

rows.small_tier: HDR Photo Package, condo up to 1,500 sq ft
rows.notes: Greenville, NC company; pricing guide lists Myrtle Beach among areas served. Free drone photos in photo packages. Twilight = Virtual Dusk $10/image. Video = 30-second highlight reel $150. 3D = virtual tour as package add-on $99 (0-3,000 sq ft). Virtual staging $50/image. $99 late-cancel fee in busy season. Its Outer Banks landing page shows different 'starting at $165/$265' prices.

Site also offers vacation rental / short-term rental photography, but prices here are listing photography. 50-99 edited images per shoot. Tiers $225 / $250 / $275 / $300 / $350 (4501+). Twilight = virtual $15 (real twilight $150). Drone 10-15 shots $160. Travel fee may apply over 30 minutes from studio; resorts with many amenities may add a small fee.

rows.small_tier: Typical-sized apartment (e.g. Airbnb or rental listings)
rows.notes: 'Starting at' $150 for apartments; homes priced by size and number of rooms (no figure). Package includes 40+ edited images and drone 'if desired'. 360 tours offered, no price. Money-back guarantee.

rows.small_tier: Airbnb / rental package, up to 1,500 sq ft
rows.notes: Prices from the business's online order form (hd.pics booking platform), not a separate pricing page. Airbnb/rental packages carry extended licensing; photo count not specified; over 9,000 sq ft custom quote. Twilight = virtual twilight per image (real twilight $250). Video = Standard Reel $195. 3D = Matterport $300 listed in luxury section (up to 5,000 sq ft). Travel fee line shown with no amount; service area not stated on form.

Nashville-based Airbnb/STR specialist. Prices are interior photos only; exterior photos are an add-on ($20 for 1-3, $50 for 5-10). Largest tier listed is 3-4 bedrooms (no 5-bedroom tier). Twilight = 1 virtual twilight edit ($50 for 3). Drone (~5 photos $175, ~10 $215) and 15-sec reel ($175) only bookable as add-ons to photos. No photo count stated. Read in built-in browser (plain fetch returned 403).

Site says 'Photography / Video for Short-Term Rentals & Real Estate', location given only as Nashville, TN. +$10 per additional image. Twilight $399 includes drone twilight. Drone $299/10 images, $399/20. Video = premium video $999 (drone video $1,249; twilight video $499 on twilight page). No turnaround or travel fees stated.

Airbnb/VRBO tiers: $250 / $300 (to 2,000) / $400 (to 3,000) / $500 (to 4,000) / $600 (to 5,000); over 5,000 quote. Drone photos and extended STR usage license included. Twilight = real twilight, 5 photos $200. Video = social media reel $175 (drone photo+video package $250). 3D = Zillow 3D $150 up to 2,500 sq ft; Matterport $225. Based in South Tampa: Kissimmee is outside free 30-mile range, then $15 per 10 miles. Search snippet showed older lower tiers; page read today shows the values here.

rows.small_tier: Photo Package, flat for all sizes
rows.large_tier: Same flat Photo Package (FAQ: typical 4-8 bedroom home needs 40-75 images)
rows.turnaround: Photos 24 hours; video 48 hours; Zillow 3D 1-3 business days
rows.notes: 'From $219'. Drone aerials and an AI twilight exterior included; a real twilight shoot is an extra evening visit at an unstated fee. Video or Zillow 3D tour only via $349 Photo + Video or 3D package (pick one); $499 Total Package has both plus up to 10 virtually staged photos. AI social reels $40, AI virtual staging $5/photo. No travel fees (same rate card across cities).

Page says vacation homes/Airbnbs must book the Vacation Home package (game rooms, theaters, converted garages count as bedrooms); a 4-bedroom home is $300. Tiers continue $400 (9-12 br), $450 (13-16 br). Photo count not stated for vacation packages (residential packages: 25 HDR for $250 up to 1,500 sqft). Drone = separate aerial package $200 (10 images). 3D = Zillow 360 walkthrough $200 under 3,500 sqft. Based in Haines City, FL; no travel fee stated.

Separate 'Airbnb Experience' package $350 (40-55 HDR photos, 10 drone shots, shared amenities) for resort/vacation-community homes. Premium 3,501+ sqft $320 includes a twilight photo. Drone shots included in every package. Twilight add-on $12 (type not specified). Video = Instagram video story $75 (Reels walkthrough $95). 3D = Zillow 360 + floor plan $95 up to 3,000 sqft. Virtual staging $18/image only. Free within 35 miles of Orlando, then +$20 to +$50 distance fee.

rows.turnaround: 1-2 business days (small); up to 5 business days (4000)
rows.notes: Vacation-rental listing marketplace that sells its own photography to homeowners. Prices '+ tax'; checkout totals on the same page show $200/$300/$400 instead of $300/$400/$525 (contradiction). Package 2500 $400; over 4,000 sq ft custom quote. Travel fee for Corolla Light north and Rodanthe south (unstated). Photos licensed 3 years. No add-ons listed.

Outer Banks vacation rental package page; prices 'From'. 7+ bedroom $480. Flambient tier starts $450/$525/$600. Minimum 70 interior/exterior/aerial photos plus 30+ detail shots (intro says 60+, inconsistent). Drone aerials and basic 2D floor plan included. Additional travel fee may apply (unstated). Twilight/video/3D pricing only in a PDF not read.

rows.turnaround: 72 hours for Airbnb/short-term rental (48 hours for MLS)
rows.notes: Yucca Valley; markets itself as an Airbnb photographer serving Joshua Tree/Palm Springs, but the bedroom tiers are its general interior/exterior photography (not a named STR package). 1BR $160 (25-30 photos), 2BR $180, 3BR $200, 4BR $225, 5BR $250 (40-45 photos). Drone $50 = 5 photos; twilight $150 = 15-20 photos; bundles day+twilight+drone 2BR $330 to 5BR $400. FAQ says 'from $160-$240', contradicting the $250 5BR tier. Does not stage (refers to The Styled Property). No video/3D/travel fee stated.

Real estate & STR photography for Coachella Valley + Morongo Basin; packages not size-tiered. Base $500 (no stated photo count; FAQ: a 3BR/2BA with pool typically yields 25-35 images). Base + Drone package $750 (no standalone drone price). Luxury 'starting at $2,000' includes dawn/dusk, aerials, supplemental lighting. No video/3D/styling/travel fee stated. Delivered images are owned by client for any use.

rows.small_tier: House or condos up to 2 bedrooms
rows.notes: Vacation rental photography 'starting at $149' up to 2 bedrooms; 'Larger unit or house? Add $75 per bedroom' (larger prices not written out, so large = null). Photos for VRBO/FlipKey/HomeAway/Airbnb. Serves Destin, Miramar Beach, PCB, Navarre, 30A, Fort Walton. Rush fees extra (unstated); no drone/twilight/video/3D prices on page.

Page targets rental condos ('give your rental property a WOW factor'), but packages are named real estate. Includes all interior photos + some building common-area exteriors (no count stated). Single family home $240 up to 2,000 SF, +$50 per additional 500 SF. Aerial $80; 30-second social media video $45; 'Digital image adventure package' (local attractions) $100. No turnaround or travel fee stated.

rows.small_tier: Standard rental photos, smallest size (range $239-$409 by size)
rows.turnaround: Most photo galleries next delivery day; video 2-3 delivery days
rows.notes: Own-prices article on the business's site (dated Nov 18 2026). Vacation rentals priced on a separate ladder: Standard rental $239-$409 by size; Luxury rental (includes on-site staging and advanced lighting) $499-$899; bundles Rental Essentials $349-$489 up to Rental Luxe $1,399-$1,929. Add-ons from https://panhandleproductions.net/services/real-estate-photography/ : virtual twilight $29/photo (twilight session $289), aerial add-on $100 to a booked shoot, social media reel $249 (photo-to-video reel $150), Zillow 3D $159 (Matterport $199). rows.small_tier: Essentials (STR listing media, no size tiers)

Stay-trade offered. Turnaround not formally stated.

Lehi, UT; Park City page (https://monarca-media.com/areas/park-city) says Park City is in standard coverage with no travel fee. Twilight $200 = real twilight; drone video $150 (drone photos bundled in packages, no standalone price); video $175 = vertical walkthrough. Drone/twilight add-ons listed without prices. Has an Airbnb/VRBO page (https://scatterscape.com/what-we-do/airbnb-vrbo-short-term-rental/) but no STR-specific prices. Travel fees not mentioned.

rows.turnaround: 24-48 hours for most STR photography packages

NJ-based; service area includes Monroe County, PA (Poconos). The Details $285 (50 photos). Drone add-on $115 (5-10 photos). Floor plan $70 / $85 with measurements. Unlimited commercial usage included. Shoot 1-2 hours. No twilight, video, 3D, turnaround or travel fees listed.

rows.small_tier: Airbnb Photography base service (single floor: 25-40 photos)
rows.notes: Single $799 price shown although the page lists photo counts by size up to 4,501-6,000 sq ft (100-115 photos); unclear if larger homes cost more. Complete package (photos + twilight + aerial) $1,497. Twilight $399 and aerial $299 without stated photo count. Lifestyle, 3D tour and video offered without prices.
